headline: 756 listed companies disclose value-up plans… their market cap share tops 83%
summary: The number of listed companies disclosing value-up plans rose to 756. As of end-August, their combined market capitalisation was 5,074 trillion won, or 83.4% of KOSPI and KOSDAQ.
why: Value-up disclosures are South Korea's corporate governance initiative to raise shareholder returns and valuations on the KOSPI and KOSDAQ.
